facts.fact: The Bank of Mozambique granted PawaPay, through its subsidiary Quidexplus Mozambique, a Payment Service Provider licence, announced by PawaPay on 8 October 2026.

MOZ.note: No consumer-protection rule or redress body stated.
Expanded inbound flows are only in advanced discussion; no corridor is piloted, licensed or in service.
No government payment to people stated.
Only a count of active mobile money accounts, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: PawaPay says Mozambique's mobile money market exceeds 12 million active accounts across three operators: M-Pesa (Vodacom), e-Mola (Movitel) and mKesh (Tmcel).

MOZ.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
